$comment: House of Ichigo 3.3 → 3.4 proposals. Machine-readable; merge into brand.config.json. Every block below is either a NEW node or an AMENDMENT to an existing node at the same path. Style slots hold references, keywords or composites only. Source id S6 is proposed for the 3.4 reference set (see sources_add). Decisions already in `reconcile` (R1–R27) are not reopened. Owner (S0) delegated the 3.4 decisions on 11 Oct 2026.

S6.title: 3.4 reference set, cloned under /home/claude/refs/ — impeccable (Apache-2.0), refero (MIT), emilkowalski skills (MIT), vercel web-interface-guidelines (MIT), lucide (ISC), motion-primitives (MIT). Adopted only where 3.3 is silent or contradicts itself; never against a 3.3 prohibition.

library.$note: R12 confirmed. Lucide is drawn with round joins; 3.3 p50 asks square joins where the form is architectural. Known deviation, accepted until the master set exists — do not fake it with stroke-linejoin:miter on rounded geometry. absoluteStrokeWidth stays false: p50 says the stroke scales proportionally (1.6 at 24, 1.07 at 16).

sizes.$note: 32 removed. The only uses refero gives 28–32px (feature cards, empty-state illustration, marketing) are uses 3.3 refuses (p39, p88). An icon never illustrates.

pairing.rule: icon size follows the adjacent text: 14–16px text → 16; 16–18px text or a button label → 20; a heading or a stepper number → 24
pairing.align: center, then an optical shift of up to 1px toward the point for chevrons and arrows

a11y.icon_only_button: aria-label naming the action; visible text preferred

set.$note: HOI name → Lucide file name (verified in lucide-icons_lucide/icons/). Replaced one for one when the master set is drawn.

ui_set.$note: The interface set the website and platform need. `mirror` is the RTL flag (p103 rule: chevrons, back arrows, progress and the stepper mirror; numerals, the mark, media controls do not).

list.use: close an overlay, drawer, chip or banner

list.name: arrow-up
list.use: sorted ascending column; back to top

list.name: external-link
list.use: a link that leaves the site or opens a new tab; always with the label

list.name: check
list.use: success, a done step, a selected option — Ink, no fill (p86)

list.name: triangle-alert
list.use: attention / warning message and the HOI risk icon

list.name: ellipsis

list.name: circle-user
list.use: user menu fallback when no initials

list.name: file-text

list.name: loader-circle
list.use: the spinner, only where the shape of what arrives is unknown

list.name: command
list.use: the ⌘ glyph in shortcut hints on macOS

list.name: corner-down-left
list.use: the Enter key in shortcut hints

list.name: chart-scatter
list.use: the quadrant view in platform nav

list: a solid or duotone variant for marketing (refero allows it; p50 does not)
a second library on any surface
an icon inside the website pillar block or any feature row (p39)
a CSS filter on an icon or a client logo (p49)

stagger_ms.$note: One value, not a range. Used only where a list arrives as a list: the authored moment, and rows that arrive after a scoring run. Never on sections, never on menus.

hover_gating.$note: Amends the WO default `(hover:hover)`. Applies to every :hover rule, colour included: a tap on touch leaves a false hover on the control.

tiers.always: 100+ times a day — palette, focus ring, tabs, sidebar collapse, keyboard shortcuts, sort: instant, no transition
tiers.often: tens a day — hover, row navigation, select open: colour only, fast
tiers.occasional: dialogs, drawers, toasts, the mobile nav: the overlay assignments on p81
tiers.rare: first-time surfaces: no delight budget. 3.3 bans decorative animation; the one exception is the authored moment.

properties.tooling: CSS transitions first; CSS keyframes for the authored moment (off the main thread); WAAPI when JS must sequence; motion.dev only for the four motion-primitives components that survive the kit review. will-change only on the quadrant group while it plays, removed after.
properties.svg: transforms on a <g> wrapper with transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center

asymmetry.$src: S6:refero motion.md:101-105; emil animate/SKILL.md:147; impeccable animate.md:61
asymmetry.rule: Exit is one duration step shorter than enter and uses the exit curve. Exits are opacity-only; enters may add a transform. An element leaves the way it came (a drawer slides back to its edge, a toast back to block-end).
asymmetry.$note: Fills the gap p81 leaves for drawers and toasts (one duration stated, no direction). Overlay enter/exit on p81 already follows this rule.

skeleton_timing.$note: p100: under 1s nothing, 1–10s a skeleton. Data loads show the skeleton after 300ms (Vercel's window), model responses after 1000ms (p100). The pulse is two deliberate halves (400 + 400), so no single transition exceeds the ceiling.

spinner.$note: Only where the shape of what arrives is unknown (p88). One rotation is two deliberate halves. Linear: constant motion (emil STANDARDS.md:24).

map.$comment: component → [property, duration token, easing token]. 'instant' means no transition. Every row satisfies p81; rows marked S6 fill a gap.

tabs.$note: a shared-layout sliding indicator is banned: it animates layout and runs on the main thread during navigation

accordion.$note: height is a layout property (p81). The panel appears; the chevron turns.

sidebar_collapse.$note: width is layout; keyboard-driven; tens of times a day

toast.driver: transition, never keyframes — toasts stack and retarget

palette.$note: Mod+K is a keyboard shortcut used 100+ times a day. e3 scrim appears without transition.

header.$note: no shrink, no hide-on-scroll: scroll-linked movement is banned (p81)

section_reveal.$note: no in-view fades on sections or rows (p81 decorative ban; craft-floor.md:13)

statistics.$note: a counting number is the statistic-band default p52 rejects

reduced_motion.rule: Every duration drops to 0ms except opacity, which keeps fast.
reduced_motion.spinner: keeps rotating (it is the only signal that work continues)
reduced_motion.authored_moment: no draw-in; the whole quadrant fades in once at fast

authored_moment.value: the use-case quadrant drawing in on the Platform page
authored_moment.rule: One per site, not per page. Functional motion everywhere else.
authored_moment.trigger: IntersectionObserver, threshold .5, once per page view; not scroll-linked — a one-shot trigger, position never drives a frame. If already in view at load, plays after document.fonts.ready.
authored_moment.default_state: visible. The hidden start state is set by a class JS adds before first paint; with JS off the quadrant is simply there (craft-floor.md:71).
authored_moment.driver: CSS keyframes on a class; lines use pathLength=1, stroke-dasharray 1, stroke-dashoffset 1→0; dots are <g> groups with transform-box fill-box
authored_moment.interruption: runs to completion (≤ 1.1s); never retriggered; never blocks links or scroll

timeline.element: partition segment 2: impact = 60, from readiness 50 to the right edge
partition segment 3: readiness = 65, from impact 60 to the top
zone labels: Fix foundations first · Batch or defer · Plan carefully · Start now

timeline.property: opacity 0→1 and scale .9→1 in place, stagger 40

authored_moment.reduced_motion: all elements opacity 0→1 together, fast; no draw, no scale
authored_moment.$note: Every element stays under the 400ms ceiling (p81); the sequence is a stagger, which R10 permits. Dots appear in place because the position is the product's answer (p61) — a dot that travels would say the score moved.

allowed.dialog: with ease/duration replaced by the brand tokens and `backdrop:backdrop-blur-xs` removed (blur is banned, p73)
allowed.transition-panel: tab and stepper panel crossfade, opacity only, fast
allowed.in-view: only as the trigger of the authored moment; never for section or row reveals
allowed.disclosure: chevron and content toggle only, with the height animation removed (p81)

banned.animated-number, sliding-number: a counting statistic is the band p52 rejects; the proof line is static
banned.border-trail, glow-effect, spotlight, pr: decoration; glow, blur and filters are banned (p44, p73)
banned.carousel, infinite-slider: a marquee is movement without a cause; the logo wall is static
banned.image-comparison: the comparison_pair layout is two images side by side (p48), not a slider
banned.morphing-dialog, morphing-popover: layout animations on the main thread
banned.ui/button, ui/input, ui/label, ui/toolti: the config's own components carry these

components.$comment: NEW and AMENDED components in the config grammar. `$src` S0 = owner-delegated 3.4 decision; the reference that informed it is in $note and in `provenance`. Keys named for paint hold references, keywords or composites only.

button.$comment: AMENDMENT: adds the destructive variant and the on-dark secondary. Everything else unchanged.

destructive.$note: p77 measures white on danger (4.68) and white on danger-hover (6.31): a filled danger control is in the ramp. Used only inside a confirm dialog, with the consequence in the label (p97). Never on a working screen, never for cancel.

secondary_on_dark.$note: The secondary button inside an Ink section (CTA band, conviction band). Primary stays Cobalt on Ink (p24).

link.$comment: NEW. Inline text link. R24: inline links are underlined; tertiary buttons are not.

external.$note: icon after the label; rel=noopener; the label says where it goes

link.$note: Navigation is always an <a>; never a button or a div with a click handler (vercel README.md:33).

skip_link.$comment: NEW. First focusable element on every page, site and platform.

header.$comment: NEW. Website header. p52 gives labels and the CTA; the rest fills a gap.
header.rule_behaviour: the hairline appears only once the page has scrolled (class toggle, no transition); at rest the header sits on the white ground with no rule
header.position: sticky, block-start; never shrinks, never hides on scroll
header.scroll_margin: every heading gets scroll-margin-top equal to the header height

logo.label: House of Ichigo — home
logo.$note: The lockup is portrait (670/790) and its minimum is 72px high (p14): it does not fit a 64px bar. Below the minimum the rule is 'drop to the mark' — so the mark alone, at 40px, linked to Home. The lockup lives in the footer.

nav.pillar_current: on a pillar page the current item's edge may take that pillar's colour — the one place wayfinding colour appears in the header (p52: 'a pillar page takes that pillar's colour in the section rule')

layout.desktop: mark · nav (inline-start, after a sp-6 gap) · spacer · language switch · CTA
layout.tablet: mark · spacer · language switch · CTA · menu button (nav moves to the mobile drawer below 1024)
layout.phone: mark · spacer · menu button; language switch and CTA inside the drawer

header.a11y: <header> landmark; nav is <nav aria-label='Main'>; the current page carries aria-current=page

mobile_nav.$comment: NEW. The drawer the menu button opens below the desktop breakpoint.
mobile_nav.behaviour: focus trapped; Esc closes; focus returns to the menu button; body scroll locked; overscroll-behavior contain

language_switch.$comment: NEW. EN · FR at launch; AR joins when the locale ships.
language_switch.form: text links, the locale code in mono eyebrow case: EN · FR
language_switch.behaviour: each link points at the same page in the other locale (hreflang); aria-current=true on the current locale; lang attribute on each link; never a flag; never a dropdown for two options
language_switch.$src_behaviour: S6:vercel README.md:79 (language from settings, never from location)

breadcrumbs.$comment: NEW. Site: article and programme pages only. Platform: top bar, max 3 levels.
breadcrumbs.phone: only the parent, prefixed with arrow-left
breadcrumbs.a11y: <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'>, an <ol>, aria-current=page on the last item

footer.$comment: NEW. 3.3 has none. On Cool Grey, never Ink: the CTA band above it is the Ink closing section and two Ink surfaces never touch (p45).

layout.desktop: 12 columns: rail (3) lockup 72px + tagline; columns 4–6 Training, 7–9 Advisory, 10–12 Company; then a hairline and the legal line
layout.tablet: rail full width, then three columns of 8/3
layout.phone: stacked: lockup, three lists one under another with a hairline between, then the legal line

legal_line.content: House of Ichigo SAS · Auxerre, France · the four legal links · language switch · © year
legal_line.$note: The registered entity and the URL, never an individual's details (p66). No social icons (p67): LinkedIn is a text link.

never: a newsletter form (the library gate is the only sign-up)

hero.$comment: AMENDMENT of patterns.web.hero, as a component. R23: hero 88px, lead 18px.
hero.grid: 12 columns; text in 1–7; the product screenshot starts at column 8 and bleeds past the container's inline-end edge, cropped like the mark (p52)

proof.format: 4,000+ professionals · 500+ companies · Europe, the Gulf and Africa

screenshot.source: the platform at 2x, real data or the p52 illustrative set
screenshot.dimensions: explicit width and height to prevent layout shift

hero.motion: none; content visible at first paint

responsive.phone: text full width; screenshot below at 100vw + 10% bleed to the inline-end, height 240; proof line under it
responsive.tablet: text 8/8; screenshot below at full width with bleed

pillar_block.$comment: NEW. The four pillars on Home and Training. Rules and the rail, no cards, no icons (p39, S1:layout.prohibited).

layout.desktop: four columns of 3/12 in one row (the 4-per-row ceiling, p46)

column.rule_note: {color.pillar.<pillar>} per column — the only coloured rule (S1:layout.rules.pillar)

title.content: the pillar name, exactly as p40; Build with AI carries 'your team builds' as a second line in {type.caption}

states.hover: nothing on the column; the tertiary link carries the hover

pillar_block.a11y: a <ul> of four <li>; the pillar colour always appears with the pillar name (p25)

programme_list.$comment: NEW. The three tiers of one pillar. A list, not cards. No duration, no price (S1:catalogue.no_menu).

delivery_line.content: In person, virtual or hybrid · English and French · groups of 6–20
delivery_line.$note: group size is allowed; duration and price are not

row.layout_desktop: tier label in the rail (3/12), programme in 4–12

programmes_block.$note: The AI Enablement Program, AI Transformation Consultant Programme and Corporate AI Academy use the same row, under a heading 'Programmes', on the Training page only

framework_block.$comment: NEW. One framework (Advisory). On a pillar page: one; on Advisory: four stacked.
framework_block.layout_desktop: rail (3/12): eyebrow 'Advisory · <pillar>' and the framework name as {type.heading_lg}; body (4–12): two lists

title.$note: a proper noun (p40): no accent word inside it

terms_line.content: Fixed scope, fixed output, priced per engagement, never per day.

stage_strip.$comment: NEW. The platform's six stages in display form (Platform page). The stepper without a current state.

line.content: what the platform produces at that stage (p98 'The platform' column)

stage_strip.rule_side: block-start on desktop and tablet; inline-start on phone

proof_line.phone: wraps to three lines, separators dropped

logo_wall.$comment: NEW. Client logos, with written permission each (ABOUT_US §5). Omitted entirely until supplied: a placeholder is worse than nothing (p49).

logo.treatment: as supplied, one colour where the client provides one

logo_wall.layout: one wrapping row, left-ranged; never a marquee, never a carousel
never: CSS grayscale or opacity on a logo (p49: no filter; p77: no opacity)

conviction_band.$comment: NEW. The Ink pull-quote block (p45). One per page at most, never adjacent to the CTA band.
conviction_band.layout: rail empty; statement in columns 4–11, left-ranged (p46 asymmetry)

cta_band.$comment: NEW. The closing Ink section (p45). Last section before the footer on every page except legal and 404.
cta_band.layout: heading and line in columns 1–7; buttons under the line; desktop padding-block sp-7, phone sp-6

article_list.$comment: NEW. Insights index. Rows, not cards.

title.link: the whole title is the link; underline on hover

row.image: none by default; the first row may use split_46_54 with a real session photograph

filter.form: a row of pillar links above the list, current one with the 2px Cobalt rule of {component.tabs}; state in the URL (?pillar=)

article_list.gate_position: after the third row, and at the foot
article_list.date_format: day month year, locale-aware (Intl.DateTimeFormat, long month), set in mono
article_list.$note: p92's DD/MM/YYYY governs the interface; the editorial surface takes the written month. Recorded here so it is a rule, not drift.

article.$comment: NEW. Article page. type.setting applies: 45–75ch measure, left-ranged.
article.layout_desktop: rail (3/12): eyebrow, date, author, reading time, breadcrumbs; body (4–11): prose at 75ch max
article.layout_phone: rail content above the title, then the prose
article.images: one of the five image layouts, with a mono caption below (S1:images.captions); real sessions only

library_gate.$comment: NEW. The Discover library sign-up: the lead magnet. An e1 panel on Insights, at the end of each article, and the whole /library page.

form.validate: on blur; on submit focus the first error
form.layout: fields stacked on phone; name and company side by side on tablet and desktop, email full width

success.form: inline message replaces the form: what was sent, where, what to do next

contact_form.$comment: NEW. Contact page. A form plus the faster route beside it.
contact_form.layout_desktop: form in columns 1–7; the rail at 9–12 holds email, address and the scoping-call link
contact_form.layout_phone: rail content first, then the form

fields.name: message
fields.label: Message
fields.help: What you want to run, and by when.

contact_form.submit_behaviour: enabled until the request starts; then disabled with the label 'Sending…'; Ctrl/⌘+Enter submits from the textarea

rail.email: a mailto link with the mail icon
rail.address: House of Ichigo SAS, Auxerre, France

consent.$comment: NEW. Cookie notice. Shown only if non-essential cookies exist; with server-side or cookieless analytics it is not rendered at all.
consent.$note_actions: refusing is one click, the same weight and the same row as accepting; no 'manage' maze; not dismissed by scrolling; no X
consent.role: region aria-label='Cookie notice'; not a dialog, focus is not trapped
consent.remember: choice stored for 6 months; a link in the footer legal line reopens it
never: a banner that blocks the hero

not_found.$comment: NEW. 404, site and platform. S1:ux.errors.absent: what was expected here and the nearest way back.
not_found.layout: rail empty; title and links in columns 4–10

links.form: three tertiary links in a column

never: a search box the site does not have

section.$comment: NEW. The page section wrapper that enforces the dark rhythm.
section.cadence: one Ink section per two or three white; never two adjacent; the CTA band is the last section (p45)
section.a11y: each section has one h2; headings in order; id for anchors with scroll-margin-top

pagination.$comment: NEW. Site lists and platform tables.
pagination.state: in the URL (?page=, ?size=); Back restores scroll
pagination.a11y: <nav aria-label='Pagination'>; aria-current=page; disabled prev/next are aria-disabled and remain focusable
pagination.phone: summary line, prev and next only

top_bar.$comment: NEW. Platform top bar. Ink, like the sidebar (p45 'platform chrome').
top_bar.layout: sidebar toggle (panel-left, 1024+) · breadcrumbs · spacer · search trigger · tasks · user menu

search_trigger.form: a secondary_on_dark button: search icon, 'Search', then the shortcut in a kbd

top_bar.phone: mark 32px · screen title · user menu; the bottom bar carries navigation (p104)

bottom_bar.$comment: NEW. Below 600px the sidebar becomes a bottom bar (p104).
bottom_bar.overflow: a fifth item 'More' opens the remaining screens in a drawer; nothing is removed (p104 'never hiding a control without moving it somewhere reachable')

side_panel.$comment: NEW. The non-modal detail panel at 1440+ (p104 'sidebar, working column and a detail drawer, all at once'). A drawer without a scrim.
side_panel.focus: not trapped; opening moves focus to the panel heading; closing returns it

filter_bar.$comment: NEW. Fills patterns.dashboard.filter_bar. Sits above a table at compact density.

filter.label_inline: the field name as a prefix inside the control: 'Function: All'

clear.label: Clear filters
clear.shown: only when a filter is active

filter_bar.persistence: in the URL and remembered per screen (p97 'filters persist')
filter_bar.phone: search stays; filters collapse into a 'Filters' button that opens a drawer, with the active count in the label
never: a filter icon without a label
auto-apply that re-sorts under the pointer

table.$comment: AMENDMENT. Adds sort indicators, truncation, selection bar, and the column rules the book leaves implicit.

truncation.text: end, with the full value in title and in the row's detail panel
truncation.wrap: never in compact or dense; cells keep the row height

selection_bar.appears: when one or more rows are selected; replaces the filter bar row, same height
selection_bar.content: '3 selected' · actions as secondary buttons · Clear

table.long_text: overflow-wrap anywhere on emails and URLs; flex children min-width 0

kpi.$comment: NEW. The one hero metric (p61). Never three tinted cards.
kpi.loading: a skeleton 4ch wide at the numeral's height; the label stays
kpi.empty: the numeral reads 0 and the label stays; the empty state below says what to do

quadrant.$comment: NEW as a component (patterns.quadrant holds the cuts). The signature of the product (p61). One series; never four equal boxes.

axes.ticks: none; the cuts are the only marks

partition.segments: readiness 50 full height; impact 60 from readiness 50 to the right; readiness 65 from impact 60 to the top

label.position: the outer corner of each zone

dot.$note_pillar_fill: fill takes {color.pillar.<x>} once, on that pillar's own screen (p85)

blocked.$note: a governance-blocked use case is the one semantic exception; the badge beside the label says why

label.beyond: label on hover and focus; the list beside carries the names

quadrant.interaction: dots are buttons; arrow keys move between dots in score order; Enter opens the use case in the side panel; the list beside is linked both ways

layout.tablet: chart full width, min-height 360, list below
layout.phone: not drawn: the list sorted by score with the zone word per row (p104 'the scorecard becomes a list')

states.loading: axes and partition drawn, no dots, no labels
states.empty: axes drawn; the empty copy and 'Map a use case' sit in the Start now zone

quadrant.rtl: does not mirror: readiness increases left to right in both directions, as the score meter does (p103); labels translate
quadrant.motion: motion.map.quadrant_platform on the platform; motion.authored_moment on the website

file_upload.$comment: NEW. Documents for the governance check and the registry.

control.label: Choose a file
control.input: a real <input type=file>, the button is its label

help.position: above the dropzone, like a field's help (p82)
help.content: accepted types and the size limit, with a space before the unit: 20 MB

never: an upload that loses the queue on a failed file

user_menu.$comment: NEW. Avatar and account menu in the top bar.

avatar.shape: square — the circle is reserved for the mark and the spinner (shape.circle)
avatar.initials: first letter of the first and last name; one letter if one name; the circle-user icon if neither

user_menu.org_switcher: only when the person belongs to more than one organisation; a sub-list under the head

task_tray.$comment: NEW. Where work longer than 10s lives (p100: a named task the person can leave and return to).

row.name: {type.body}
row.progress: words and numerals, never a bar alone (p83)
row.done: check in Ink and the word; a link to the result

task_tray.live: polite; a toast when a task finishes while the person is on another screen

kbd.$comment: NEW. A key in a shortcut hint.
kbd.platform_symbols: ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere; joined with a narrow no-break space

shortcuts.$comment: NEW. The keyboard shortcuts list. A dialog opened by ? and from the user menu.

list.action: Move between rows, dots and menu items

never: a shortcut that fires while typing in a field
single-letter shortcuts without a modifier beyond / and ?

confirm.$comment: NEW. The destructive confirmation (p89 example, p97 rule).
confirm.title: names the object: 'Discard this blueprint?'
confirm.body: names the consequence and what cannot be undone, ≤ 30 words

confirm.label: the consequence as a verb phrase: 'Discard eight components'

never: a danger fill on the dialog
an Undo toast in place of the dialog

empty_state.$comment: NEW as a component (p88 rules). Copy per screen in copy.<lang>.platform.empty.
empty_state.layout: left-ranged in the working column, top-aligned, max-width 48ch

error_recovery.$comment: NEW. The six classes of p99 as components.

input.message: under the field, names the rule and a correct example

permission.form: {type.caption} in {color.muted}: who can, and how to ask

conflict.body: what changed, who changed it, when

transient.message: that the work is saved, then the retry

model.refusal: what it will not do and what the person can do instead

offline.message: You're offline. Changes save when you reconnect.

optimistic.$comment: NEW. Where the interface may update before the server answers (vercel README.md:18), bounded by p97 'nothing generated is applied without a human'.

focus_route.$comment: NEW. Focus and announcement on route change.
focus_route.on_navigate: focus moves to the screen's h1 (tabindex -1); scroll to top; document.title updates; the aria-live polite region stays silent (the title change is the announcement)

live_regions.assertive: one, at the app root: a failure that stops work

focus_route.unsaved_guard: warn before leaving a form with changes (beforeunload and router guard)

format.$comment: NEW. Number and date formatting per locale. p92 gives the date; the thousands separator is read from the book's own tables (p84: 1 248, 1 090).
format.relative: today 14:32 · yesterday · then DD/MM/YYYY; never '3 weeks ago'
format.thousands: narrow no-break space (U+202F) in both locales

percent.fr_note: narrow no-break space before the sign

currency.decimals: 0 or 2, never mixed in one view

format.units: a narrow no-break space before the unit: 20 MB
format.numerals: mono tabular in data; display tabular in statistics (R5)
format.implementation: Intl.NumberFormat and Intl.DateTimeFormat with the group separator replaced; never a hand-built string

truncation.identifiers_and_files: middle-truncate, keep the extension and the last 6 characters
truncation.unbreakable: overflow-wrap anywhere on emails, URLs and identifiers; flex children min-width 0
truncation.names: never computed initials from a single character of a multi-byte string
truncation.$src: S6:emil break-ui/CATALOG.md; vercel AGENTS.md Content Handling

long_loading.button: label stays, spinner replaces nothing, width unchanged (p76); label gains an ellipsis: 'Scoring…'
never: a percentage for the six stages

skeleton.shape: the shape of what arrives: rows at the row's height, a numeral at 4ch, a paragraph at three lines of decreasing width
skeleton.a11y: aria-busy on the region; no text

save.label: Save changes

save.state: enabled always; disabled only while the request runs

tooltip.$note: The first tooltip in a toolbar waits 100ms; while one is open, moving to a sibling shows the next with no delay.

input.$comment: AMENDMENT: attributes the book leaves implicit.
input.attributes: autocomplete and name on every field; type and inputmode match the answer; spellcheck off for emails, codes and names; paste never blocked; typing never blocked (validate after)

focus.$comment: AMENDMENT: grouped controls and sticky chrome.
focus.within: :focus-within on a compound control (search field with icon, the chip field) shows the input's focus border
focus.sticky: sticky headers, the bottom bar and banners never cover the focused element: scroll-padding equals their height

pages.$comment: Section sequence per page, with the surface. w = white, i = Ink. The cadence rule (p45) is enforced: never two i adjacent, at most one i per two or three w, the cta_band last.
home: framework_block (Advisory, four in one row of names + one line each, link to Advisory) w
pillar: hero (pillar colour in the section rule, CTA Cobalt; screenshot of that pillar's platform screen) w
boundary statement as a section with the heavy rule w
advisory: how an engagement runs: stage_strip reused with the stages the frameworks draw on w
platform: hero (screenshot: the dashboard; secondary CTA 'See the six stages' anchors down) w
quadrant — the authored moment, with the p52 illustrative data w
what each framework draws from it: four rows w
licence and white-label: one paragraph + cta inline w
insights: article_list with filter and gate w
about: hero (photograph via full_bleed_scrim, a real session) w
who we are: prose at 75ch w
legal: prose at 75ch with an in-page contents list in the rail w

legal.layout: article prose, no accent word, no CTA band, last-updated date in the rail

web.scroll: no scroll-driven effects; anchors use scroll-margin-top; back/forward restores position

performance.fonts: preload the three variable files, font-display swap, latin subset only at launch

screens.$comment: The six navigation screens (p87) with their empty state and hero metric.

copy.$comment: UI strings. EN en-GB, FR vous, « » with U+202F inside. Short, declarative, no banned word, no exclamation mark. Placeholders in braces are substituted by the app, not token references.
